title: Ek number, paanch reactions
format: Kitty Gang reaction chain on the Mithai Thali game: one call, a fast cut of faces

experiment.hook: Megha and Tanya on the Mithai Thali home art, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above them, Megha says 'Kaju Katli bas ek number door!' with chip 'AGLA NUMBER KISKA?'
experiment.variable: rhythm: after one call (44) the reel is five single-face shots of about 2 s each, one reaction and one line per gang member, with the theme's reactions flying on every cut, instead of a story with a setup
experiment.hypothesis: a new face every 2 s and no setup to sit through fixes the middle: watched % above 20 (best so far 17), skip under 64%, at least 1 share on Diwali eve

idea: Diwali eve Mithai Thali game: the ball pops 44 and each friend reacts in her own way: Megha finishes Kaju Katli on her cheat day, Ishita claims Gulab Jamun too early, Myra asks why Ras Malai has only 3 numbers, and deadpan Aditi wins Soan Papdi, again.
beats: hook: Megha one number away from Kaju Katli / call: 44 / reaction 1: Megha cheat day / reaction 2: Ishita claims early / reaction 3: Myra confused by Ras Malai / button: Aditi gets Soan Papdi phir se
caption: {theme} Housie mein aap kaun ho: Megha, Ishita, Myra ya Aditi? Comment karo, aur us saheli ko tag karo jise har Diwali Soan Papdi milti hai!

lines.text: Kaju Katli bas ek number door!
lines.say: काजू कतली बस एक नंबर दूर!

lines.text: Poori! Aaj toh cheat day hai!
lines.say: पूरी! आज तो चीट डे है!

lines.text: Ras Malai mein teen hi number?
lines.say: रस मलाई में तीन ही नंबर?
